snippet.description:
In this short, AIR 207 Sugandha recalls the advice she received from Karandeep Singh Sir: write just 1–2 answers every day. You don't need to write an entire paper or finish every answer within 7 minutes in the beginning. 
First, focus on building content, structuring your answers and reproducing what you have studied on paper. Speed and time management improve with consistent practice.

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or 2028? Start small, practise daily and build your answer-writing skills for Mains.

#UPSC #UPSCMains #AnswerWriting #UPSCPreparation #AnthropologyOptional #KarandeepSinghSir #AIR207 #UPSCStrategy #LevelUpIAS
